result.instructions: Tools for LeadSquared, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find every lead with an email address at acme.com and list their owners."; "Which leads were created this week, and which of them have no task yet?"; "Show the activities and opportunities for the lead John Smith.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes LeadSquared data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run leadsquared_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run leadsquared_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run leadsquared_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. leadsquared_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: leadsquared_quick_search_leads
tools.title: Quick search leads
tools.description: Find leads whose first name, last name, email, phone, mobile, company, city or country contains a text. Same as the Quick Search box in LeadSquared. GET LeadManagement.svc/Leads.GetByQuickSearch.

text.description: The text to find, for example an email address or a surname.

tools.name: leadsquared_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: Return one lead's details (name, email, phone, owner, custom fields) by ProspectID. Returns an empty list when the id does not exist. GET LeadManagement.svc/Leads.GetById.

lead_id.description: The lead's ProspectID (a GUID), from a lead search or lead lookup.

tools.name: leadsquared_search_leads
tools.title: Search leads by criteria
tools.description: Find leads where one lead field matches a value, for example CreatedOn after a date, or EmailAddress equal to an address. Pass the field's schema name (LookupName) and the operator (SqlOperator, for example = or > or LIKE). POST LeadManagement.svc/Leads.Get.

lookup_name.description: Schema name of the lead field, for example EmailAddress, FirstName or CreatedOn.

lookup_value.description: The value to compare with, for example 2026-01-01 00:00:00 for a date.

sql_operator.description: Comparison operator: =, <>, >, <, >=, <=, LIKE, or NOT LIKE.

columns.description: Comma-separated field names to return, for example ProspectID,FirstName,EmailAddress.

tools.name: leadsquared_get_lead_tasks
tools.title: Get lead tasks
tools.description: List the tasks (follow-ups, calls, to-dos) created against one lead. GET LeadManagement.svc/RetrieveTaskByLeadId.

lead_id.description: The lead's ProspectID (a GUID), from a lead search or lead lookup.

tools.name: leadsquared_get_lead_activities
tools.title: Get lead activities
tools.description: List the activities (calls, emails, notes, custom activities) of one lead, newest data included. Pass an activity_event code to keep one type only. POST ProspectActivity.svc/Retrieve.

lead_id.description: The lead's ProspectID (a GUID), from a lead search or lead lookup.

activity_event.description: Activity event code, for example 201 for a custom activity. Omit for all types.

tools.name: leadsquared_get_lead_opportunities
tools.title: Get lead opportunities
tools.description: List the opportunities linked to one lead, with their fields. Pass opportunity_type to keep one opportunity type only. POST OpportunityManagement.svc/GetOpportunitiesOfLead.

lead_id.description: The lead's ProspectID (a GUID), from a lead search or lead lookup.

opportunity_type.description: Opportunity type code. Omit for all types.

tools.name: leadsquared_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the LeadSquared account (name, email, role, active status). Use it to find an owner's user id. GET UserManagement.svc/Users.Get.

tools.name: leadsquared_create_or_update_lead
tools.title: Create or update lead
tools.description: Create a lead, or update the lead that already has this email address or phone number. Pass the fields as name and value pairs using schema names, for example FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress, Phone, Company. POST LeadManagement.svc/Lead.CreateOrUpdate.

search_by.description: Field to match an existing lead on, for example EmailAddress or Phone. Default: email, then phone.

tools.name: leadsquared_post_lead_activity
tools.title: Post activity on lead
tools.description: Add an activity (for example a note or a custom activity) to one lead. Each call adds a new activity: it is not idempotent. POST ProspectActivity.svc/Create.

lead_id.description: The lead's ProspectID (a GUID), from a lead search or lead lookup.

activity_event.description: Activity event code of the activity type, for example 201 for a custom activity.

activity_datetime.description: When the activity happened, as yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss in the account time zone.

prompts.title: Get started with LeadSquared
prompts.description: What you can do with LeadSquared here, with example requests to try.
